items.title: Hinton Milt — Smithsonian Jazz Oral History
items.q: Yes, he was… because before that we had band arrangements and some of the guys in the band, including Benny Payton were making arrangements and they wasn‟t quite up to what Chick Webb was playing and Chick was swinging.
